unsw_nb15.notes: 7-feature model. No model beats the 'flag everything' baseline (F1 0.612) by more than 0.02. Init_Win_bytes_* are semantically mismatched (0-255 vs 16-bit range).

cicddos2019.notes: Class is 98.6% attack, so F1 is dominated by prevalence. No model beats the 'flag everything' baseline (F1 0.9931) at any threshold: no usable signal.

cse_cic_ids2018.notes: Final RF: no threshold beats the trivial baseline. LR and XGBoost keep ranking signal (ROC-AUC 0.986/0.960; oracle best F1 0.991/0.943 vs baseline 0.527), i.e. default-threshold miscalibration. KS analysis shows packet-length features among the most shifted.
